name: kolayxport
description: Ask about your Etsy, eBay, Trendyol, Shopify and Wix orders, listings, sales and marketplace fees in KolayXport, and stage listing changes as drafts you review in KolayXport.

interface.longDescription:
KolayXport is an order, listing and finance panel for online sellers on Etsy, eBay, Trendyol, Shopify and Wix (and Amazon, for sellers who already connected it). This app gives ChatGPT read access to the data KolayXport has already synced for your account, so you can ask questions in plain language.

Orders: your latest orders across marketplaces, with the buyer's country and the full money breakdown (items, discounts, shipping, tax, total, price paid against the current listing price).
Listings and stock: search your listings, see full details, and find items that are almost out of stock.
Sales and finance: order counts and gross sales per marketplace, marketplace fees by type, ad spend, refunds, net profit, payouts and the latest payment account balance.
Listing quality: audit a listing against each marketplace's rules, check a proposed title or tags, and look up search demand and competition for a keyword.

ChatGPT can also prepare changes for you: new titles, descriptions, tags, prices or stock, a new listing draft, or photos for a listing. These are saved as drafts in KolayXport only. Nothing changes on a marketplace until you open the draft in KolayXport and send it yourself.

Privacy: ChatGPT only sees your own account. Buyer names and shipping addresses are shared only if you tick a separate checkbox when connecting (off by default). Amazon buyer data, e-mail addresses and phone numbers are never shared.

Requires a KolayXport account with at least one marketplace connected.
defaultPrompt: What was my most recent Etsy order, and how much were the discount, shipping and tax?
What did Etsy charge me in fees in the last 30 days, and what is my Etsy balance?
Which of my listings are at 2 or fewer in stock?

positive.description: Latest order with its money breakdown
positive.prompt: What was my most recent Etsy order, and how much were the discount, shipping and tax?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Etsy order 9990000100001 from KXReviewDemoShop (open, shipping to NL): items subtotal 64.00 USD, discount 9.60, shipping 12.00, tax 13.28, total 79.68, one Telkari Filigree Earrings at 64.00. Ship-to country only: no buyer name, address, e-mail or phone.

positive.prompt: Which of my listings are at 2 or fewer in stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 10 listings across Etsy, eBay and Trendyol, lowest first: two at 0 (eBay Terracotta Turkish Towel KXREVIEW-PST-02, Trendyol Telkari Gümüş Kolye KXREVIEW-TY-0006), then the ones at 1 and 2 (e.g. Etsy Sage Green Handmade Mug at 1).

positive.prompt: What did Etsy charge me in fees in the last 30 days, and what is my Etsy balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the synced Etsy finance summary for the last 30 days: fees by type (transaction, processing, listing renewals) and ad spend, net profit with its formula, payouts to the bank, and the current Etsy payment account balance (about 1,284.60 USD) with the time it was synced. Says held funds are not available for Etsy.

positive.prompt: Audit my Sage Green Handmade Mug listing on Etsy and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Etsy listing 9990000001003 and returns its score out of 100 with each check, worst first, and what to fix (for example weak tags, no shipping profile, more photos, a longer title and description), plus the Etsy title and tag rule check.

positive.description: Prepare a title change as a draft only
positive.prompt: Write a longer title for my Sage Green Handmade Mug Etsy listing and save it as a draft. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the new title as a KolayXport draft for Etsy listing 9990000001003 and returns staged: true, changed: title, and a reviewUrl on kolayxport.com. The live Etsy listing does not change; the reply says the seller reviews and sends the draft in KolayXport.

negative.prompt: Publish my new mug title to Etsy right now.
Give me the e-mail address and phone number of the buyer of my latest Etsy order.
Show me the orders and sales of another KolayXport seller.

review.commerce_description: KolayXport for ChatGPT does not sell products or take payments. It reads the seller's own synced data and saves listing changes as drafts the seller sends in KolayXport.

publication.release_notes: Review test cases added. Order, listing, stock and finance questions, listing checks, and listing changes saved as drafts the seller sends in KolayXport.
